name: Analog Poly
explanation: A five-voice polyphonic analog synthesizer modelled feature-for-feature on the Sequential Prophet-5 Rev 4 (User's Guide v1.3). Per voice: Oscillator A with simultaneous sawtooth and variable-width square/pulse waves (polyBLEP) and hard SYNC to Oscillator B; Oscillator B with simultaneous sawtooth, triangle and pulse waves, FINE tune, LO FREQ (turns it into a per-voice LFO) and KEYBOARD-off switches; frequency knobs stepped in semitones over four octaves; a mixer for Osc A, Osc B and white noise; a resonant self-oscillating 24 dB low-pass filter with the Rev 4 REV switch selecting two genuinely different voicings (Rev 1/2 SSM 2040-style: rawer, brighter tap, near-linear envelope segments; Rev 3 CEM 3320-style: saturating ladder with exponential envelope curves), envelope amount, and off/half/full keyboard tracking; dedicated filter and amplifier ADSRs with per-envelope velocity switches and the classic RELEASE switch (off = fast release on both envelopes); POLY MOD routing the filter envelope and audio-rate Oscillator B into Osc A frequency (exponential FM), Osc A pulse width and filter cutoff; an LFO with saw/triangle/square shape switches (any combination; saw and square positive-only, triangle bipolar, 0.022-500 Hz); the WHEEL-MOD section with an LFO-to-noise source-mix knob and Freq A / Freq B / PW A / PW B / Filter destination switches, ridden by the mod wheel on top of the LFO INITIAL AMOUNT; the VINTAGE knob (4 = tight modern Rev4 ... 1 = loose Rev1) scaling per-voice random spread of oscillator pitch, filter cutoff, envelope times and amp gain plus slow drift; GLIDE; UNISON with 1-5 voice stacking, detune 0-8, chord memory and LO/LO-retrig/LAST/LAST-retrig key priority; spring-loaded pitch wheel with 1-12 semitone bend range, mod wheel, aftertouch (pressure) routable to filter and/or LFO amount, MASTER TUNE (about a semitone each way) and the A-440 reference tone. Switch groups are bit-packed into single host parameters; the panel shows every individual switch.
